environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) with TCP passthrough on port 443. No application-layer inspection. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The application runs as a systemd service with Python 3.9 and Flask 2.2.x. SQLite database stored on local EBS volume. No reverse proxy or middleware between NLB and application.
